description: This file implements a web page for changing user passwords, including form validation, password visibility toggle, and AJAX submission for updating the password.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines user instance number based on session login user.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects to 'at_a_glance.php' to cancel password change.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to update password configuration and handles response.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates password change and initiates configuration update.
